integrity: The all-isomorphism reduction is proved by averaging an arbitrary positive-definite quadratic form over a genuine norm isometry. The reduced optimization is exhaustive on both quadrant sectors and uses analytic inequalities; numerical values are checks only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only real two-dimensional Day--James spaces with 2<p<infinity and second quadrant exponent infinity. It does not settle 1<=p<2, general ell_p-ell_q planes, higher dimensions, or classify all nonsymmetric optimal pullbacks.
title: Exact Euclidean distance of the Day--James \(\ell_p-\ell_\infty\) planes above the Hilbert exponent
